samples.title: Island ledgers: Proof strip
samples.statement:
An inspector follows each cable family fully before starting another unvisited switchboard island. Tomas rolls a fresh proof strip into the office typewriter. The supervisor wants the readings in their precise working order before signing the file.

links is a symmetric 0/1 adjacency matrix. Start a depth-first traversal at each still-unvisited vertex, in increasing index order. Produce the number of vertices in each component, in that start order.

Return the entire derived sequence, preserving its order.

Implement islandLedgersProofStrip(links, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Island ledgers: Floor ticket
samples.statement:
An inspector follows each cable family fully before starting another unvisited switchboard island. Ivo is checking the lower stop before the ribbon press opens. A negative reading is a real measurement and must not be replaced by an invented zero.

links is a symmetric 0/1 adjacency matrix. Start a depth-first traversal at each still-unvisited vertex, in increasing index order. Produce the number of vertices in each component, in that start order.

Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement islandLedgersFloorTicket(links, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Island ledgers: Boss receipt
samples.statement:
An inspector follows each cable family fully before starting another unvisited switchboard island. Pia adds numbered weights to the final receipt at the unit's inspection desk. The first derived reading has weight one, so its position matters as much as its value.

links is a symmetric 0/1 adjacency matrix. Start a depth-first traversal at each still-unvisited vertex, in increasing index order. Produce the number of vertices in each component, in that start order.

Return the weighted sum of the derived sequence: multiply its first value by 1, its second by 2, and so on, then add the products. Return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement islandLedgersBossReceipt(links, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
